purpose: Thirty extra actual-play recordings at the END of the original seventy subscriber items: twenty remote-facility / environmental / ancient-science sessions, then ten ancient Sith-temple / dark-side sessions.
public_scope: General Star Wars RPG creative inspiration. Section A: remote alien research stations, android production, environmental risk, survival; Section B: Sith tombs, ancient relics, Jedi trials, dark-side mysteries. No private-world locations, NPC names, session secrets or original story canon.

selection_policy.subtitle: Some programs are non-Star-Wars sci-fi actual plays. They are explicitly cross-genre, not Star Wars canon.
selection_policy.strict: Each requested episode must match a known publisher RSS title via episode-specific fragment; no generic first episode fallback, no invented audio, no trailers, no previews, no unverified enclosures.
